notes.title: 9.1 Updates
notes.content:
[h2]1. Fix bugs[/h2]
- Fixed so that the helmet you are wearing does not disappear when crafting a gem
- Fixed the cost to appear correctly when forge
- Fixed to enable gold bar crafting
[h2]2. Price change[/h2]
- Forge prices lowered for some items
- Costume Forge cost changed from lyng to topa
[h2]3. Removed Essence Crafting[/h2]
